(rule! (lambda (g)
         (reduce (lambda (acc pos)
                   (let* ((r (fst pos))
                          (c (snd pos))
                          (v (at g r c)))
                     (if (zero? v)
                         acc
                         (reduce (lambda (g2 dir)
                                   (let ((dr (fst dir))
                                         (dc (snd dir)))
                                     (reduce (lambda (g3 d)
                                               (let ((nr (+ r (* dr d)))
                                                     (nc (+ c (* dc d))))
                                                 (if (and
                                                       (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                                       (zero? (at g nr nc))
                                                       (zero? (at g3 nr nc)))
                                                     (set-cell g3 nr nc v)
                                                     g3)))
                                             g2
                                             (range 1 (max h w)))))
                                 acc
                                 diagonal-deltas))))
                 g
                 (grid-positions g))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
      (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
             (sources (filter (lambda (p) (not (zero? (at g (fst p) (snd p)))))
                              (grid-positions g)))
             (ends (reduce
          (lambda (acc pos)
            (append acc
              (map (lambda (dir)
                     (reduce
                       (lambda (last d)
                         (let ((nr (+ (fst pos) (* (fst dir) d)))
                               (nc (+ (snd pos) (* (snd dir) d))))
                           (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (list nr nc) last)))
                       pos (range 1 (max h w))))
                   '((-1 -1) (1 1)))))
          '() sources))
             (stage-a ((lambda (g)
         (reduce (lambda (acc pos)
                   (let* ((r (fst pos))
                          (c (snd pos))
                          (v (at g r c)))
                     (if (zero? v)
                         acc
                         (reduce (lambda (g2 dir)
                                   (let ((dr (fst dir))
                                         (dc (snd dir)))
                                     (reduce (lambda (g3 d)
                                               (let ((nr (+ r (* dr d)))
                                                     (nc (+ c (* dc d))))
                                                 (if (and
                                                       (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                                       (zero? (at g nr nc))
                                                       (zero? (at g3 nr nc)))
                                                     (set-cell g3 nr nc v)
                                                     g3)))
                                             g2
                                             (range 1 (max h w)))))
                                 acc
                                 '((-1 -1) (1 1))))))
                 g
                 (grid-positions g))) g))
             (color (at g (fst (first sources)) (snd (first sources)))))
        (reduce
          (lambda (acc pos)
            (reduce
              (lambda (g2 dir)
                (reduce
                  (lambda (g3 d)
                    (let ((nr (+ (fst pos) (* (fst dir) d)))
                          (nc (+ (snd pos) (* (snd dir) d))))
                      (if (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (zero? (at g3 nr nc)))
                          (set-cell g3 nr nc color) g3)))
                  g2 (range 1 (max h w))))
              acc '((-1 1) (1 -1))))
          stage-a ends))))
